1. (Currently Amended) A process for obtaining a valued material from an aqueous suspension, dispersion or solution containing the valued material comprising adding to the aqueous suspension, dispersion or solution a Maillard reaction product, the Maillard reaction product comprising an adduct of (1) an amine reactant and (2) a reducing sugar, a reducing sugar equivalent, or a mixture thereof, __wherein the Maillard reaction product is produced by heating the amine reactant and the reducing sugar to a temperature sufficient to form covalent bonds between the amine reactant and the reducing sugar__.

2. (Currently Amended) A process for emulsifying a material comprising agitating the material in a suitable liquid in the presence of a Maillard reaction product, the Maillard reaction product comprising an adduct of (1) an amine reactant and (2) a reducing sugar, a reducing sugar equivalent, or a mixture thereof. (Previously presented)

3. (Currently Amended) The process of claim 1, wherein the amine reactant contains at least one amine functional group, and wherein a molar ratio of the reducing sugar, the reducing sugar equivalent, or the mixture thereof to the amine functional group is about 1:1 to about 3:1, __and wherein the Maillard reaction product exhibits a degree of browning or color development indicative of advanced Maillard reaction stages__.

4. (Currently Amended) The process of claim 1, wherein the reducing sugar, the reducing sugar equivalent, or the mixture thereof is selected from the group consisting of: dextrose, fructose, high fructose corn syrup, erythrulose, ribulose, xylulose, psicose, sorbose, tagatose, glyceraldehyde, erythrose, threose, ribose, arabinose, xylose, allose, altrose, mannose, gulose, galactose, talose, maltose, lactose, furfural, pyruvaldehyde, acetaldehyde, crotonaldehyde, 2-furaldehyde, glycolaldehyde, glycolaldehyde dimer, trans-3-(2-furyl)acrolein, acrolein, 5-hydroxymethylfurfural, 5-methylfurfural, 4-hydroxycrotonaldehyde, and cinnamaldehyde, and wherein the amine reactant is selected from the group consisting of: ammonia, ammonium hydroxide, hydrazine, guanidine, primary amines, secondary amines, quaternary ammonium compounds, polyamines, amino acids, and proteins, __and wherein the Maillard reaction product is produced by thermal treatment of the amine reactant and the reducing sugar__.

5. (Currently Amended) The process of claim 1, wherein the Maillard reaction product has a cationic functionality, a sulfur functionality, a phosphorus functionality, a sulfate functionality, a sulfonate functionality, a hydroxamic acid functionality, a silane functionality, a phenolic functionality, or an aza crown chelating functionality, __and wherein such functionality is introduced through reaction of the amine reactant with the reducing sugar during Maillard reaction product formation__.

6. (Cancelled)

7. (Currently Amended) The process of claim 1, wherein the Maillard reaction product is produced by reacting the amine reactant, the reducing sugar, and a non-carbohydrate polyhydroxy reactant, __wherein the non-carbohydrate polyhydroxy reactant is selected from the group consisting of glycerol, sorbitol, mannitol, xylitol, and ethylene glycol__.

8. (Currently Amended) The process of claim 1, wherein the Maillard reaction product is produced by reacting the amine reactant, the reducing sugar, and a polycarboxylic acid, __wherein the polycarboxylic acid is selected from the group consisting of citric acid, tartaric acid, and malic acid__.

9. (Currently Amended) The process of claim 1, wherein the valued material is obtained by sedimentation, filtration, or flotation, __and wherein the separation is enhanced by the selective interaction of the Maillard reaction product with the valued material or impurities present in the aqueous suspension, dispersion, or solution__.

10. (Currently Amended) The process of claim 1, further comprising recovering the valued material from the aqueous suspension, dispersion or solution after adding the Maillard reaction product thereto to produce a purified product, wherein the purified product contains a reduced concentration of at least one impurity relative to the aqueous suspension, dispersion, or solution, __and wherein the Maillard reaction product selectively modifies the surface properties of the valued material or impurities to facilitate separation__.

11. (Currently Amended) The process of claim 1, wherein the Maillard reaction product depresses the valued material or an impurity in the aqueous suspension, dispersion, or solution, __by modifying the flotation behavior or sedimentation characteristics of the valued material or impurity__.

12. (Original) The process of claim 1, wherein the Maillard reaction product promotes flotation of the value material or an impurity in the aqueous suspension, dispersion or solution.

13. (Currently Amended) A process for separating a valued material from a suspension, dispersion, or solution, comprising: treating the liquid suspension, dispersion, or solution with a Maillard reaction product of (1) an amine and (2) a reducing sugar, a reducing sugar equivalent, or a mixture thereof, __wherein the Maillard reaction product is produced by thermal treatment of the amine and the reducing sugar__, to provide a treated mixture; and removing a purified valued material from the treated mixture.

14. (Currently Amended) The process of claim 13, wherein the Maillard reaction product further comprises a non-carbohydrate polyhydroxy compound or a polycarboxylic acid, __and wherein such compound or acid is incorporated during thermal treatment of the amine and the reducing sugar__.

15. (Cancelled)

16. (Currently Amended) The process of claim 13, wherein the amine contains at least one amine functional group, and wherein a molar ratio of the reducing sugar, the reducing sugar equivalent, or the mixture thereof to the amine functional group is about 1:1 to about 3:1, __and wherein the Maillard reaction product exhibits a degree of browning or color development indicative of advanced Maillard reaction stages__.

17. (Currently Amended) The process of claim 13, wherein the reducing sugar, the reducing sugar equivalent, or the mixture thereof contains an aldehyde moiety reactive with Cu+2 to produce a carboxylic acid moiety, __and wherein such aldehyde moiety is present in the reducing sugar prior to Maillard reaction product formation and is not generated as a result of the Maillard reaction__.

18. (Currently Amended) The process of claim 13, wherein the reducing sugar, the reducing sugar equivalent, or the mixture thereof is selected from the group consisting of: dextrose, fructose, high fructose corn syrup, erythrulose, ribulose, xylulose, psicose, sorbose, tagatose, glyceraldehyde, erythrose, threose, ribose, arabinose, xylose, allose, altrose, mannose, gulose, galactose, talose, maltose, lactose, furfural, pyruvaldehyde, acetaldehyde, crotonaldehyde, 2-furaldehyde, glycolaldehyde, glycolaldehyde dimer, trans-3-(2-furyl)acrolein, acrolein, 5-hydroxymethylfurfural, 5-methylfurfural, 4-hydroxycrotonaldehyde, and cinnamaldehyde, and wherein the amine is selected from the group consisting of: ammonia, ammonium hydroxide, hydrazine, guanidine, primary amines, secondary amines, quaternary ammonium compounds, polyamines, amino acids, and proteins, __and wherein the Maillard reaction product is produced by thermal treatment of the amine and the reducing sugar__.

19. (Currently Amended) The process of claim 13, wherein the Maillard reaction product depresses the valued material or an impurity present in the treated mixture, or wherein the Maillard reaction product promotes flotation of the valued material or the impurity in the treated mixture, __by selectively modifying the surface properties or flotation behavior of the valued material or impurity__.

20. (Currently Amended) The process of claim 13, wherein the purified valued material is removed from the treated mixture by sedimentation, filtration, or flotation, __and wherein the separation is enhanced by the selective interaction of the Maillard reaction product with the valued material or impurities present in the treated mixture__.
